content_units: Best Lisbon Hotel Pick for Your Family Stay

For   2026-07-12 to 2026-07-15 (3 nights)  , the best fit is   Hotel Alpha  . It stays within your   €540 total cap  , includes breakfast, has a   family room  , private bathroom is implied by the room-based hotel setup, and offers   walkable access to central sightseeing  .
Ranked Hotel Options
Rank   Hotel   Total Stay Cost   Breakfast   Access   Family Fit   Budget Fit
1   Hotel Alpha     €495     Included   12-min walk to Rossio   Family room     Yes
2   Hotel Cais     €537     Included   20-min tram to center   Family room     Yes, very tight
3   Hotel Bairro     €498     Extra   3-min walk to metro   Standard room + rollaway bed     Yes, but weaker fit
Option 1:   Hotel Alpha     Best overall balance of price, included breakfast, and central access     €495 total
Choose Alpha
-   Why it ranks  1:   It meets all your must-haves cleanly and leaves   €45 under budget  .
-   Best advantage:   A   12-minute walk to Rossio   is excellent for a family trip, reducing transit friction with a 6-year-old.
-   Main tradeoff:     No elevator   could be inconvenient if you have a stroller, heavy luggage, or get assigned a higher floor.
Option 2:   Hotel Cais     Best backup if you want a nicer setting and family room     €537 total
-   Why it ranks  2:   It also meets the breakfast and family-room requirements and stays just under budget.
-   Best advantage:   Likely the most pleasant atmosphere thanks to the   riverfront   setting.
-   Main tradeoff:   It uses up nearly the full budget and needs a   20-minute tram ride to reach the center  , which is less convenient for sightseeing-heavy days.
Option 3:   Hotel Bairro     Cheapest base rate, but weakest match for your stated needs     €498 total with breakfast
-   Cost breakdown:   €148 × 3 nights =   €444   room total; breakfast adds   €18/day   for 2 adults + 1 child, so   €54   extra; total   €498  .
-   Why it ranks  3:   It does have   easy metro access   and stays under budget.
-   Main tradeoff:   Breakfast is   not included  , and a   standard room plus rollaway bed   is usually less comfortable than a proper family room for 3 nights.
Family Trip Tradeoff Guide
-   Best for convenience:     Hotel Alpha
-   Best for scenery:     Hotel Cais
-   Best if metro access matters most:     Hotel Bairro
-   Best overall value under your constraints:     Hotel Alpha
Booking Context
I treated your   budget cap as total stay cost including listed breakfast charges   and assumed each hotel has a   private bathroom  , since that is standard unless specifically noted otherwise.
